Mara: ok this is peak noon energy — behold my roommate's fennec fox commandeering a shipping box 📦🦊
Mara: dropped a pic: https://imgur.com/gallery/placeholder (will replace with IRL pic later)
Devin: those ears could pick up Wi‑Fi from mars 😭
Kyle: tiny fox, massive attitude. 10/10 would let it sit on my laptop :heart_eyes:
Sasha: is that a built‑in sunlamp? it looks photosynthesizing 🌞😆
Devin: also — name? does pip demand snacks on schedule?
Mara: she’s called Pip. full name: Pipeline, because she sneaks into boxes and workflows. low maintenance, high dramatic naps.
Kyle: Pipeline for the win. can we nominate Pip for Cuteness Council? :raised_hands:
ops-bot: FYI — lunch table reserved 12:30–1:00 today (no animals allowed in the shared kitchen per policy). Reaction :fox: added by Kyle
Sasha: @Mara pls bring Pip to the team photo day if allowed, i need content for my holiday cards
Mara: asking roommate! if yes i'll post a proper photoshoot album tomorrow — bonus: box fashion show categories (best tuck, dramatic ear flop, loaf angle)
Devin: already voted Best Tuck in my heart. :ballot_box_with_check:
Kyle: sending Pip a virtual treat. :cookie:
Mara: thank you, will relay. closing thread for now — will reopen when Pip gives consent for glamour shots :camera_with_flash:
